contract.moment: integral exp(tau max(1,||A||,||A^-1||)) <= M in fixed units
contract.actuation: A_theta=A+sum theta_j D_j; D_j >= 0; sum D_j <= A; |theta_j|<=r<1

polynomial_record_global_design.output: feasible actuated rational control, value interval, global regret <= epsilon

polynomial_record_global_design.finite_explicit_matrix_corollary: Gaussian elimination supplies the readings in polynomial bit time; continuous design only

existing_family_gauge_counterexample.exact_failed_claim: Complete boundary-response operators at all settings of an existing specified positive actuator family always determine the effective response to a newly specified positive spatial actuator.
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.parameters: tau>0, M>exp(tau); integer T0>=max(4,2*tau); dyadic 0<R<=1/4 with exp(tau)+pi*R^2*(18/T0+1)<M; T>=T0
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.geometry: unit square/torus; center (1/2,1/2); U radius R*exp(-T0); B_T radius R*exp(-T)
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.candidate_one: A1=I outside U and in B_T; on the annulus, t=log(R/radial_distance), K(t)=2*t^2/[tau*(t+log(t))], A1=K*er tensor er+K^-1*etheta tensor etheta
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.existing_actuator: D1=I*indicator(Y minus U); more generally any family supported outside U with sum D_j<=I
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.observation_equality: all full boundary operators and all periodic effective tensors agree for A0+sum theta_j D_j and A1+sum theta_j D_j
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.new_actuator: I*indicator(B_T) at any fixed amplitude s>0 (one may take s<1)
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.scope: two-dimensional symmetric matrix coefficients for a scalar equation, finite nonsingular gauges, fixed moment budget; existing-family data only, even infinite and exact
existing_family_gauge_counterexample.not_claimed: isotropic nonuniqueness; obstruction with a known coefficient; failure of all new interventions; universal runtime lower bound; classification of all ambiguities

preserved_open_items: upper effective-response sensitivity endpoint with exactly logarithmic power tau
